scope: One frozen two-word zero-mean endpoint-idle-pair override and unchanged search configuration across all complete sources. Host predictions and artifact diagnostics, not a new audio release or actual emulator proof.
timing_scope: Per-source times include preparation, workset serialization, C execution, full rendering and artifact diagnostics. A resumed attempt is not a fresh full conversion benchmark; its wall time is reported separately. TRD assembly/emulator execution is separate.
decision: Reject unconditional endpoint-idle-pair promotion:valid exact17/16 endpoints recover speech, entertainer and matched song slightly, but song remains0.137209677dB below half-joint. Steps, multitone and loud3000 regress versus matched-centered; silence is noisier than both prior idle controls. Approximately3991-Hz and11972-Hz residual lines and numeric AM/delay/background increases leave artifact acceptance unresolved. Endpoint correctness and nominal zero-mean area are mechanism evidence, not universal quality or artifact-absence proof. No new Fuse run or release promotion is warranted for this rejected candidate.
artifact_acceptance_scope: Compare compensation and half-joint at the unchanged original source clock. Legacy fitted modulation is inapplicable when drift breaks coherence. Regression counters disclose every numeric increase with arithmetic tolerance only; no user-supplied audibility threshold exists.
metadata_finalization_scope: Only final disposition and source/report authentication were added after completed host measurement. Pre-input producers, frozen pair/epsilon certificate, encoded data, source/prior, timestamps, reference, listening filter, fixed gain and every diagnostic remain preserved.
